title_original: My Undesirable Friends: Part II – Exile

blocks.text: My Undesirable Friends: Part II – Exile

The second part of Julia Loktev’s epic documentary, detailing the persecution of journalists in Russia, follows her brave protagonists’ escape abroad following the country’s full-scale invasion of Ukraine.

blocks.text: Part one of this extraordinary undertaking chronicled the work of young female journalists who faced growing repression by Vladimir Putin’s regime in the lead-up to the 2022 invasion of Ukraine. This new instalment proves even more troubling, finding the journalists scattered across different countries and grappling with their new lives, while still struggling to continue their reporting on Russia.

blocks.text: Shot over ten years, this unflinching portrait of youth in Eastern Ukraine is a rare and powerful account of the passing of time during conflict.
Acclaimed documentarian Wong Siu-pong’s moving film creates an intimate space in which three young women with terminal conditions navigate experiences of illness, care and companionship.
Master of archival film reconstruction, Sergei Loznitsa, reframes Soviet history once again via the revealing gaze of Italian cameramen who captured life there in the early 1970s.
